questions.question: Jeremy is 26 years younger than his father. Eight years hence his father’s age will be two years less than twice his age. What is Jeremy’s present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let Jeremy and his father age be M and N years respectively.

Jeremy is 26 years younger than his father,

⇒ M = N – 26

⇒ N = 26 + M

And,

Eight years hence his father’s age will be two years less than twice his age,

⇒ (N + 8) = 2(M + 8) – 2

⇒ N + 8 = 2M + 16 – 2

⇒ N – 2M = 6

Solving,

⇒ 26 + M – 2M = 6

⇒ M = 20

∴ Jeremy present age is 20 years.

questions.question: Two identical resistors of 20 Ω each are connected in parallel. This combination, in turn, is connected in series to a 10 Ω resistor. The equivalent resistance of the combination will be:
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Resistance: The obstruction offered to the flow of current is known as the resistance. It is denoted by R.
 
• When two or more resistances are connected one after another such that the same current flows through them then it is called resistances in series.
 
• The equivalent resistance in series combination is will be

 

Rser = R1 + R2 + R3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bfcb7071b92627ae7d952ef96dedb743c153f7f27da82edd38b0b35e7d53a76.png] 

 
• When the terminals of two or more resistances are connected at the same two points and the potential difference across them is equal then it is called resistances in parallel.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30a7d70c3b47f9210e7b8acf2f0eec4795b361acbd15d8b6ce804c1c388805d7.png] 

 
• The net resistance/equivalent resistance(R) of resistances in parallel is given by:

 

(1)/(R) = (1)/({{R₁)}} + (1)/({{R₂)}}

**Calculation:**__

Given that,

The value of two identical resistors i.e. 1st resistor (R1) and 2ⁿd Resistor (R2) = 20 ohm

The value of 3rd Resistor (R3) = 10 ohm

The resistances R1 and R2 are connected in parallel, so equivalent resistance (R) of both-

1/R = 1/R1 + 1/R2

1/R = 1/20 + 1/20

R = 10 ohms

The equivalent resistance (R) and 3rd resistor (R3) are in series**(in turn means series**), so equivalent resistance (R’) is

R’ = R + R3

R’ = 10 + 10

R’ = 20 ohm.

Therefore, the equivalent resistance R’ is = 20 Ω (ohms)

questions.question: ______ is the process in which acids, bases react to form salts and water.
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• The reaction of an acid with a base is called a neutralization reaction.__
 
• The products of this reaction are salt and water.
 
• For example, the reaction of hydrochloric acid(HCl) with sodium hydroxide(NaOH) produces a solution of sodium chloride(NaCl)(salt) and some additional water molecules. 
 
• The neutralization of a strong base and strong acid has a pH equal to 7.
 
• The neutralization of a strong base and weak acid will be greater than 7.
 
• The neutralization of a strong acid and weak base will be less than 7.

When acid and base react, it produces salt and water. This process is called Neutralisation.

questions.question: A train travelling at the speed of 66 km/h crosses a 300 m long platform in 24 seconds. How long was the train?
questions.solution:
Let the length of the train be A m.

Speed of train = 66kmph = 66 × 5/18 = 55/3m/sec

It crosses a 300 m long platform in 24 seconds,

⇒ 55/3 = (300 + A)/24

⇒ 440 = 300 + A

⇒ A = 140

∴ Length of train is 140 m.

questions.question:
Consider the given argument and decide which of the given assumptions is (are) implicit.

**Argument:**

The government had put advertisements and issued advisories to the public not to eat food from the roadside, as they are unhygienic.

**Assumptions:**

1. The government wants to stop roadside vendors business.

2. The government wants to increase the profit of hotel owners.
questions.solution:
The government has advised the public not to eat food from the roadside.

If either of the given assumptions had been the intention of the government, the government would have simply banned roadside vendors. It is implicit that the government wants to warn people about the risk and put pressure on roadside vendors to maintain food quality.

Hence, neither assumption 1 nor 2 is implicit.

distance travelled by particle 20 seconds be X.

questions.question: The energy released at the end of digestion is in the form of:

Thermal Energy

 
 
 
The energy inside a body due to motion/ vibration of particles/molecules inside it.

 
 
 

 
 
Kinetic Energy

 
 
 
It is the energy possessed by virtue of its motion

 K.E = ½ mv² 

 Where m = mass of a body

 v = velocity of body

 
 
 

 
 
Chemical Energy

 
 
 
It is energy stored by molecules in form of chemical bonds.

 
 
 

 
 
Electrical Energy

 
 
 
It is an energy to the flow of charge or electrons.

 
 
 

__**Explanation:**__

From the above explanation, we can see that the energy stored in chemical bonds are known as chemical energy

Thus the **energy released at the end of digestion** will be **chemical energy.**

questions.question: If secθ + tanθ = 2, then secθ – tanθ = ?
questions.solution:
Given,

⇒ secθ + tanθ = 2

⇒ (secθ + tanθ)(secθ – tanθ) = 2 × (secθ – tanθ)

⇒ sec²θ – tan²θ = 2 × (secθ – tanθ)

⇒ (secθ – tanθ) = 1/2 = 0.5

questions.question:
Consider the given argument and decide which of the given assumptions is (are) implicit.

**Argument:**

The year 2020 is a leap year.

**Assumptions:**

1. February will have 29 days in 2020.

2. The year 2017 is not a leap year.
questions.solution:
In the given statement, it is assumed that we know the definition of a leap year which is a year every four years according to the Gregorian calendar, which has 366 days with 29 February as an extra day.

**Assumption I: **February of 2020 will have 29 days.

The assumption implicit is that February of a leap year has 29 days.

**Assumption II:** Year 2017 is not a leap year.

Because every fourth year is a leap year, by dividing the year by 4, we can determine whether a given year is a leap year or not. Since 2017 is not divisible by 4, we can say that 2017 is not a leap year.

**Hence, both assumptions 1 and 2 are implicit.**

questions.question: 15% of a number, when added to 30% of another, gives 24% of the sum of the two numbers. The bigger number is 4 more than the smaller one. What are the numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the smallest and the largest number be M and N respectively.

15% of a number, when added to 30% of another, gives 24% of the sum of the two numbers,

⇒ 15% of M + 30% of N = 24% of (M + N)

⇒ 15M + 30N = 24M + 24N

⇒ 9M = 6N

The bigger number is 4 more than the smaller one,

⇒ N = M + 4

⇒ N = 6N/9 + 4

⇒ 3N = 36

⇒ N = 12

⇒ M = 8

∴ Two numbers are 12 and 8

questions.question: Which of the following has the same unit as energy?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• **Force**: Force is defined as produce of mass times acceleration.

 
 
• SI unit of force is the Newton (N).
 
 

Force = mass x acceleration

 
• Work: Work is measured by the product of force and displacement of the body along the direction of the force.

 
 
• SI unit of work is Joule (J).
 
 
 
• Energy: The capacity of doing work by a body is called its energy.
 
 
• SI unit of energy is Joule (J).
 
 
 
• Density: Density is the mass per unit volume.
 
 
• SI unit of volume is the cubic meter.
 
• 
 
SI unit of density is kilogram per cubic meter (kg/m3).

 
 
 

**Explanation:**__

From the above explanation, we can see that,

__
 
• Work has the same unit as energy.
 
• The SI unit of both Work and energy is Joules(j).
